skills.name: Mobile attack surface mapping
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest for components and permissions.
2. List deep links and exported components.
3. Note backup/debuggable flags.
4. Summarize entry points.
5. Save the map (file.write).

skills.name: Sensitive data storage audit
skills.description: Check how the app stores secrets.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apktool.decode; file.search for prefs/db usage.
2. Inspect device files via root.exec (your app).
3. Scan for plaintext tokens (python.run_file).
4. Recommend EncryptedSharedPreferences/Keystore.
5. Report findings.

skills.name: Logcat leakage audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run the app; capture logcat via process.exec.
2. Grep for token/password patterns (python.run_file).
3. Correlate with code (file.search Log calls).
4. Recommend log hygiene.
5. Record leaks.

skills.name: Mobile network layer audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture app traffic (http.capture).
2. Check for cleartext endpoints (http.history).
3. Review usesCleartextTraffic in manifest (re.apk.manifest).
4. Note pinning presence (failure behavior).
5. Report.

skills.name: Certificate pinning assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Attempt MITM capture (http.capture).
2. Note failure modes when pinning blocks.
3. Differentiate pinning vs cleartext blocks.
4. Document bypass preconditions conceptually (own app).
5. Report.

skills.name: Backup-based data extraction
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check manifest flag (re.apk.manifest).
2. Create a backup on your device (adb backup via process.exec).
3. Inspect the archive contents (re.hex.identify + unzip).
4. Assess sensitive data exposure.
5. Recommend allowBackup=false.

skills.name: Deep link abuse testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enumerate links (re.apk.manifest).
2. Fire crafted intents (process.exec am start).
3. Observe parameter handling (androidreadscreen).
4. Probe for injection into webviews/intents.
5. Report.

skills.name: Exported component probing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List exported components (re.apk.manifest).
2. Invoke each with crafted intents (process.exec am).
3. Observe behavior and data returned.
4. Automate the probe list (python.run_file).
5. Report access issues.

skills.name: WebView hardening review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search smali for setJavaScriptEnabled/addJavascriptInterface.
2. Check file access flags.
3. Note URL validation before load.
4. Recommend hardening defaults.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Keystore usage review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for KeyStore/KeyGenParameterSpec in smali.
2. Note hardware-backed usage.
3. Check key validity scopes.
4. Recommend strong specs.
5. Record.

skills.name: Root detection mapping
skills.description: Locate root checks in the app.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search smali for su/busybox strings.
2. re.ghidra.analyze native checks if present.
3. Map each check to a bypass layer.
4. Document (no live bypass without consent).
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Frida/Xposed detection review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for frida/xposed strings in smali.
2. Check /proc scanning patterns in native libs (re.rabin2 strings).
3. Map to enforcement points.
4. Document findings.
5. Keep within authorization.

skills.name: Smali exploitation patch flow
skills.description: Patch an app for research (owned app).
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apktool.decode.
2. Locate the check with file.search; patch minimally (file.patch).
3. re.apktool.build; re.apk.sign; re.apk.install.
4. Verify behavior change (androidreadscreen).
5. Document the patch.

skills.name: Native library audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List libs (re.rabin2).
2. re.ghidra.analyze the interesting one.
3. Note unsafe calls (strcpy/sprintf) in decompiled views.
4. Recommend mitigations.
5. Report.

skills.name: Clipboard handling review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Observe app copy flows (androidreadscreen).
2. Check if tokens go through clipboard (file.search ClipboardManager).
3. Note exposure window risks.
4. Recommend avoidance.
5. Report.

skills.name: Screenshot blocking review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Try android_screenshot on sensitive screens.
2. Note blocked results.
3. Correlate with smali flags (file.search FLAG_SECURE).
4. Recommend coverage of sensitive screens.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Intent redirection testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find intent extras consumed into startActivity (file.search smali).
2. Craft redirection intents (process.exec am).
3. Observe privilege behaviors.
4. Document the pattern.
5. Report.

skills.name: Task hijacking awareness

skills.name: Intent fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Generate intent permutations (python.run_file).
2. Fire at exported components (process.exec am).
3. Watch for crashes via logcat.
4. Cluster crashes by stack (python.run_file).
5. Report crashes.
